title: ctenopteris kalbreyeri
intro: Ctenopteris kalbreyeri, commonly known as New Zealand fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in the treatment of various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ctenopteris kalbreyeri are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
